name: La Botica de los Abuelos
summary: La Botica de los Abuelos is a traditional Mexican herbal apothecary in Tecate, Baja California, specializing in natural remedies and botanical products rooted in generations of healing wisdom. This well-rated local establishment serves the community with authentic herbal medicines and personalized wellness guidance.
demographics: La Botica de los Abuelos serves the local community of Moderna, Tecate, attracting primarily Mexican families and residents seeking traditional herbal remedies and natural health products. The customer base typically includes middle-income households with a strong interest in alternative medicine and traditional wellness practices. Visitors range from young adults to seniors, with a particular appeal to older generations who value traditional botanical knowledge and natural healing methods passed down through families.
description: La Botica de los Abuelos, which translates to "The Grandparents' Apothecary," is a cherished traditional herbal medicine shop located in the Moderna neighborhood of Tecate, Baja California. Situated at 102 Avenida Miguel Hidalgo, this establishment honors the time-tested wisdom of traditional Mexican herbal remedies and natural healing practices. The shop serves as a cultural touchstone in the community, offering authentic botanical products, tinctures, teas, and natural remedies that have been trusted for generations. With a strong 4.4-star rating from 25 reviews, La Botica de los Abuelos has built a loyal following among locals who appreciate the personalized service and expert knowledge of traditional medicine. Open daily from 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM, the shop provides a welcoming environment where customers can receive guidance on natural health solutions and discover the healing power of traditional Mexican botanicals.
